policies.name: Verpackungsgesetz (Packaging Act)
policies.summary: Sets binding recycling quotas (currently 63% for plastic packaging) and requires producers to register and pay licence fees that fund collection.

policies.name: Single-Use Plastics Act
policies.summary: Implements the EU directive banning single-use plastic plates, cutlery, straws, stirrers, and polystyrene takeaway containers.

sources.publisher: Federal Ministry for the Environment, Germany

newsFeed.headline: Germany's bottle-deposit return rate hits 98% for plastic bottles
newsFeed.summary: Industry data confirmed 98 of every 100 plastic deposit bottles in Germany are returned, recycled, and refilled or remade.

wooby.headline: Germany returns 98% of its plastic deposit bottles. Almost all of them!
wooby.narrative: Wooby is amazed: in Germany, almost every plastic bottle you buy comes with a small deposit you get back when you return it. So 98 out of every 100 bottles get recycled. Wooby wishes every country did this.
